title: Express Service Courtesy on Delivery Claims Wrong-Item Keep Charges
content:
Under Delivery Claims, a wrong-item keep charge carries a courtesy for the delivery service the wrong parcel was sent by.

**Courtesy.** The express keep courtesy depends on the delivery service the wrong parcel was sent by: Next Business Day or Same-Day Courier gives 10%, Expedited 2-Day gives 5%, and any other service gives none.

| Service of the order that brought the wrong item | Express keep courtesy |
|---|---|
| Next Business Day | 10% |
| Same-Day Courier | 10% |
| Expedited 2-Day | 5% |
| Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground | none |

*Hypothetical:* a wrong blouse delivered by Same-Day Courier carries a 10% courtesy; had it come by Pickup Point Delivery, none.
